title: Finite affine active slopes approximate exponent vectors with discontinuous tolerance

statement.quantifiers: EVERY integer m>=1, reals a<b and arbitrary E:[a,b]^m->(0,infinity), without regularity.
statement.assertion: There exists finite nonempty h-independent slope family r_lambda in[a,b]^m with offsets b_lambda(h)=o(h^a). If h_n->0+,p^n in R^m->p in[a,b]^m and a FIXED label lambda is active at X_hn(p^n)=(h_n^p_i^n)_i for every n, then ||p-r_lambda||_infinity<E(r_lambda). All weakly tied minimizers active; approximating p^n need not be inside cube.
assumptions: Finite nonempty affine lower envelope and positive tolerance at each slope.
Offsets defined on common sufficiently small interval; no continuity required in h.

inputs: Dimension,cube and full arbitrary positive tolerance function.
outputs: Existential finite family with sequential active-slope guarantee.
interface.precision: Asymptotic strict exponent gaps; arbitrary real exponents.
costs: No uniform cardinality, bit-complexity or computable cutoff from arbitrary E asserted.
Constructed family/existence not an efficient acquired rational certificate.

proof_mechanism: Induct on dimension and fix minimum exponent t.
Successive negative offset scales favor raised slopes and control unrevised coordinates.
Compact closed bad-limit sets extend guarantee around t.
Finite minimum-exponent interval cover plus offset shifts -sum h^q force global activity into correct local family.
obstructions: Approximate vectors outside cube are necessary for boundary induction; clipping them changes guarantee.
Rational exponents/continuity cannot be assumed to obtain effective cutoff.
This geometry alone supplies neither reaction drift nor global positive absorber.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Construct activity/drift and prove classwise representative, scale acquisition, invariance and global continuation.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
